verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs say agent tasks can be started with one API call and watched executing live in managed cloud sessions, which covers the live-watching half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a human taking over a running session interactively. The CDP/WebSocket endpoint for programmatic control is a developer building block, not a human-takeover feature, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented human takeover/interactive live view mid-run, a handoff mechanism between agent and human, and independent or hands-on corroboration of live viewing.
